# InsightsOut
Coaching, community, and support for navigating change in work and life.
Founder: Nima Imani, ICF Associate Certified Coach, technologist with experience at EY and Neo4j.

## Start
Free 30-minute conversation: https://calendar.app.google/wpqVkuaH1uwFRh6cA
Organization conversation: https://calendar.app.google/8y9NgWzBLaiT414G6

## Private coaching
Six 60-minute sessions over three months, message support between sessions. $450 per month, $1,350 total.

## Small-group coaching
Three-month programs with group and private coaching, matched around career and leadership or founders and builders. Two complimentary introductory group sessions before commitment. Session allocation, schedule, start date, and price confirmed before enrollment.
Enroll by November 30, 2026, 11:59 PM Pacific for 30% off the full three-month group program. Offer does not apply to standalone private coaching. After that date this promotion has expired.
